# Chubo Knives

> > Chubo Knives specializes in premium handmade Japanese chef knives from renowned brands like Sakai Takayuki, Kazan, and Akira-Saku, offering traditional craftsmanship for professional and home cooks.

Chubo Knives is a curated marketplace for authentic Japanese kitchen knives, featuring both specialized blade types and complete knife sets. The site showcases master craftspeople from regions like Sakai and Tosa, offering carbon steel, stainless steel, and Damascus options across gyuto, santoku, sujihiki, deba, and other traditional Japanese knife styles.
